ache.title: Four new 5-stars coming, and Robin goes first
ache.note: “Four new five-star characters coming up”: that’s how this guide opens, before covering Robin’s kit, traces and Eidolons. Four upcoming banners is a lot of wanting in one sentence. Eidolons are extra copies, so adding them to a support guide nudges you past the first pull. One copy of Robin is still a whole Robin.
watch: F2P and spenders both pulled in
ache.tip: From a crowd of new characters, choose at most one, or none, and skip their Eidolons entirely.
lines: one copy is a whole character
her Ultimate is Concerto. your wallet: silence

videoData.title: Character Guide: Robin | Honkai Star Rail

textData.text: With four new five-star characters coming up, it's essential to understand their abilities. In this guide, I focus on Robin, one of the top support characters who excels as an amplifier of physical elements and in the Harmony domain. This simplified guide will walk you through her basic attack, skills, Ultimate, traces, Eidolons, and gear recommendations. Robin's Ultimate, Concerto, is key to maximizing team buffs and dealing substantial damage. I'll also provide team compositions and demonstrate how to use her effectively in battle. Whether you're free-to-play or a seasoned player, this guide will help you get the most out of Robin. If you have any questions, leave a comment and don’t forget to check out my 'Ultimate Account Guide' for Summer 2024!
